metadata.title: Chips, software are holding back the tech-friendly Nasdaq - MarketWatch

content.text:
Sept. 2, 10:12am ET
Chips, software are holding back the tech-friendly Nasdaq
While the Dow and S&P 500 are now firmly in the green, the tech-friendly Nasdaq composite continues to seesaw around the flatline, as weakness in chip and software stocks offset the big rally in Dell's stock.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index was down 0.6%, an on track for the lowest close since July 29, and the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF was falling 1.6%, after sinking 3.5% on Tuesday. The biggest decliners in those sector trackers are shares of Credo Technology, down 17.5%, and Palo Alto Networks, down 8.8%.
Meanwhile, Dell's stock is climbing 4.8% after a strong earnings report.
